text:
**My pick for a slim power bank for the iPhone 17 is the Anker Nano Power Bank (5K).**

**Best slim overall: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99**
- It's 0.34" thick, weighs 4.3 oz, and has 5,000mAh with 15W Qi2 wireless charging. Anker's page lists the iPhone 17 series as compatible.
- 9to5Mac says it's thin and premium-feeling, runs cooler than competitors, and is the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery.
- [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank) (price from Anker's page, which showed a $5 auto-applied discount ending soon). Source: [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K), about $53-70**
- Android Central's tester calls it the thinnest and lightest she's used, at about 0.27" and 104g.
- The catch is that its wireless charging tops out at 7.5W, so it's slower than the Anker.
- [Android Central review with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Best slim with more capacity: INIU SnapGo Air (10K, 25W Qi2.2), about $43-49**
- It has 10,000mAh, which is enough for roughly two charges, and your iPhone 17 can use its full 25W wireless speed.
- It also does 45W wired charging and includes a lanyard-style cable.
- It's about 0.5" thick and 195g. Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K bank.
- Sources: [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) (prices) and [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html) (slimness).

**How to choose**
- **Pocketability first:** get the Anker Nano 5K. A 5K bank usually adds only about 60-75% of a charge.
- **A full day or travel:** get the INIU SnapGo Air 10K, which stays reasonably slim and gives you 25W. Macworld also lists the Ugreen MagFlow Pro 10K as equally slim and best in its capacity test.
- **Skip the LISEN P601.** It's very thin at 0.3-0.38" but the page I found is a wholesale listing with a 100-unit minimum.

I couldn't check live prices, so confirm them at checkout.
